verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes detailed self-serve technical guides for merchants to build ACP (ChatGPT) and UCP (Google) checkout integrations via Braintree, and documents endpoints/specs merchants can implement themselves — but the broader agentic-commerce-services/Store Sync path is explicitly form-gated ('contact the AI team... PayPal AI team will follow up to guide you through onboarding') rather than self-serve, UCP additionally requires separate Google merchant registration, and all paths presuppose an existing Braintree or Orders v2 merchant relationship rather than a simple toggle/agreement. Missing for 10: a true one-click self-serve enablement without prerequisite accounts, and elimination of the manual approval/contact-form gate for full-catalog access.
